live_matches.event_name: New Zealand Women's Tour of England 2026
live_matches.description: The 2nd ODI of New Zealand Women’s Tour of England 2026 promises another exciting contest as New Zealand look to bounce back and level the series, while England aim to build on their momentum with confidence growing across the squad. With key players stepping up on both sides, who will seize control in this crucial encounter? Tune in to catch all the action from the 2nd ODI of New Zealand Women's Tour of England 2026, LIVE only on Sony LIV.
